article_title: Bethesda Confirms Fallout 5 in Pre-Production as Todd Howard Charts Elder Scrolls VI Priority

content_preview.title: Bethesda Confirms Fallout 5 in Pre-Production as Todd Howard Charts Elder Scrolls VI Priority
content_preview.summary: Bethesda Game Studios director Todd Howard confirmed Fallout 5 is in pre-production on Creation Engine 3 and named The Elder Scrolls VI the studio's top priority, days after sweeping Xbox layoffs.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Bethesda Game Studios director Todd Howard published a studio-wide update Friday confirming that *Fallout 5* has entered pre-production and that *The Elder Scrolls VI* remains the studio's "primary development focus," [according to Variety](https://variety.com/2026/gaming/news/fallout-5-elder-scrolls-6-game-updates-bethesda-todd-howard-1236814611/), which reproduced the letter in full.
